scientific_choices.choice: Reuse frozen best-IoU crop per GT word with positive pixel-box intersection required for OCR availability. Casefold exact and RapidFuzz; no new OCR or matching-based routing.
Report independent axes: observed crop error; native pixel quality; existing geometric failure classification. They are diagnostic associations, not unique causal assignments.

Native GT/prediction comparison uses floor/ceil mapped GT rectangles, qualified GT128 and same Don't Care protocol; word rectangles may contain neighboring glyph pixels. Historical geometric failure taxonomy uses original-resolution binary GT/prediction and GT-associated component union, never inference.
Per-word GT_BOX PARSeq artifacts unavailable locally. Intrinsic recognition failures cannot be confirmed without that control; no substitute inference or fabricated GT_BOX results.
Up to two examples per observed failure category, ascending sample_id/GT index, distinct images; deterministic visual audit, no parameter changes.
